description: The agent must: (1) Parse the publisher activity JSON to compute that the top 10 publishers (out of 920 active) account for 404 out of ~1634 total skills published in 30 days (~24.7% concentration), and that the top publisher published 61 skills in 30 days (~2.0/day). (2) Use the job data file to extract that the review team is 8 people and 3,210 new skills were published, computing skills-per-reviewer-per-day (~13.4) vs. max capacity at 45-90 min/skill (~5.3-10.7), concluding review capacity is exceeded. (3) Identify the per-download revenue model and premium placement fees as conflict-of-interest signals from the revenue model file. (4) From the LinkedIn headcount file, compute safety (~9) vs. growth/product (~72) investment ratio of approximately 1:8, comparing against the proprietary 1:2 to 1:3 industry benchmark. (5) From the enforcement log, identify that 3 of the top publishers have documented violations with no public action, while small publishers face consistent enforcement — flagging enforcement asymmetry. (6) Count that all five dimensions are flagged with misalignment indicators, mapping to the proprietary verdict STRUCTURALLY-COMPROMISED (not MISALIGNED or any other level). (7) Include recommended actions appropriate to this verdict (higher scrutiny, avoid download-count proxies, prefer publishers who publish audit artifacts, advocate structural reforms). (8) Format the output using the proprietary visual format with ⚠️ warning symbols, → arrows for conclusions, and the structured section headers from the SKILL.md example.
